buildingSolar.longDescription: An opening energy structure whose panels deploy while active and fold into a fortified offline state.

buildingWind.longDescription: An opening energy structure whose rotor output follows wind while its closed state trades production for durability.

buildingExtractor.longDescription: A basic extractor that produces metal from covered deposits on dry ground or the underwater bed.

buildingExtractorT2.longDescription: An advanced extractor that converts the same deposit footprint into substantially greater metal income.

buildingRadar.longDescription: An above-water contact station that locates distant airborne and surface targets without identifying them.

buildingResourceConverter.longDescription: A powered economy structure that exchanges surplus resources through one taxed conversion channel.

buildingSonar.longDescription: An underwater contact station that locates submerged targets without revealing their full identity.

towerFabricator.longDescription: An expensive radial factory that produces every tier-one domain roster from a centered construction bay.

towerBeamMega.longDescription: A twin-emitter defensive tower that projects sustained long-range beams when allied intelligence supplies valid targets.

towerBeamLight.longDescription: A compact beam emplacement for reliable direct defense against nearby visible attackers.

towerCannon.longDescription: A ballistic defense that uses long cannon fire to punish distant ground targets.

towerHelios.longDescription: An extreme-range siege emplacement whose massive cannon delivers slow, punishing ballistic fire across the battlefield.

towerAntiAir.longDescription: A dedicated missile emplacement that acquires airborne targets and protects fixed positions from air attack.

towerTorpedo.longDescription: A surface defense with paired underwater torpedo launchers for engaging submerged threats.

buildingShieldTargetingTech.longDescription: A powered technology structure that enables its owner's turrets to avoid obstructed targets and read enemy force material.

buildingShieldTech.longDescription: A powered technology structure that raises every allied shield sphere and reflector panel while active.

buildingPrecisionTargetingTech.longDescription: A powered technology structure that removes authored weapon spread for its owning side while active.

buildingRadarJammer.longDescription: A ground-based electronic warfare structure that suppresses enemy above-water radar contacts throughout its radius.

buildingSonarJammer.longDescription: A water-surface electronic warfare structure that suppresses enemy underwater sonar contacts throughout its radius.

buildingMetalStorage.longDescription: A static economy structure that increases the owning team's maximum metal stockpile.

buildingEnergyStorage.longDescription: A static economy structure that increases the owning team's maximum energy stockpile.

towerInterceptor.longDescription: A specialized point-defense tower that destroys controlled rockets and medium or heavy mortar shells in flight.

buildingTidalGenerator.longDescription: A water-only generator that produces steady energy from a surface-mounted tidal machine.
